generation.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE isolated inventory item for WorldSim concept05. Reference image1 establishes fine ink/earth-wash technique; reference image2 shows the existing item family. Copy STYLE, not their subjects or labels. Warm brown-black delicate hand-ink contour and restrained translucent pigment wash; main contour:secondary line weight2:1. At final64px contour about1px, secondary0.5px. Calm broad material planes. Sparse hatch groups slanting lower-left to upper-right, maximum2 groups of2-3 short lines per face. No speckles or all-over noise. Restrained muted earth colours, not glossy or photorealistic. Front three-quarter view looking down about20degrees; upper-left light and narrow top face. One complete object resting naturally, centered, about70percent width of square image, generous margin. Real transparent background, no ground, cast shadow, lettering, border, tile, watermark, scenery, detached chips. Full uncropped silhouette readable at64px and32px. CRITICAL ALPHA: no glow, no vignette, no ambient aura, no smoke, no dusty surround. Alpha must be exactly zero immediately outside the crisp object edge, object interior opaque. These references show the ink treatment only; do not add any reference object. Subject: EDIT Image1 bronze sword. Remove the prominent crescent crossguard, remove every projecting guard/quillon, and remove the ornate disk pommel. Replace them with plain small rounded blade shoulders joined directly to a short brown riveted grip and a modest smooth rounded grip end. Early Bronze Age cast sword, no medieval or fantasy hilt. Preserve its muted ochre bronze blade, central ridge, near-horizontal full silhouette, fine ink, calm pigment wash, transparent alpha. Images2-3 are supporting style references only. Exactly ONE whole complete sword, no other objects.
